title.original: SGLang: Efficient Execution of Structured Language Model Programs
title.zh: SGLang：结构化语言模型程序的高效执行
title.en: SGLang: Efficient Execution of Structured Language Model Programs

inclusion_reason.zh: SGLang 以专用前端语言、RadixAttention 和结构化解码运行时统一执行多调用 LLM 程序，为后续智能体与 RAG 服务提供基础 Context。
inclusion_reason.en: SGLang unifies multi-call LLM programs through a frontend language, RadixAttention, and structured-decoding runtime, providing foundational context for later agent and RAG serving systems.

abstract.zh: SGLang 由面向生成与并行控制的前端语言和高性能运行时组成，针对复杂、多调用且带结构化输入输出的语言模型程序。
abstract.en: SGLang combines a frontend language for generation and parallelism with a high-performance runtime for complex, multi-call language-model programs with structured inputs and outputs.

problem.zh: 智能体、RAG 和多轮对话包含控制流与重复前缀，普通逐请求 API 无法表达程序结构，也会重复计算 KV 和结构化解码状态。
problem.en: Agents, RAG, and multi-turn chat contain control flow and repeated prefixes; request-at-a-time APIs neither expose program structure nor avoid repeated KV and structured-decoding work.

approach.zh: 前端以生成和并行原语描述程序，运行时用 RadixAttention 复用树状前缀 KV，并以压缩有限状态机加速约束输出。
approach.en: The frontend expresses programs with generation and parallelism primitives, while the runtime uses RadixAttention for tree-prefix KV reuse and compressed finite-state machines for constrained output.

system_design.zh: 程序被编译为运行时请求图，radix 树管理跨调用前缀缓存，调度器批处理可执行节点，结构化解码器按有限状态机限制 token。
system_design.en: Programs compile into runtime request graphs, a radix tree manages cross-call prefix caches, a scheduler batches ready nodes, and the structured decoder constrains tokens with finite-state machines.

key_results.zh: 摘要报告 SGLang 在语言与多模态模型的多种复杂任务上，相比先进推理系统取得最高数倍吞吐优势。
key_results.en: The abstract reports up to several-fold higher throughput than advanced inference systems across complex language and multimodal tasks.

limitations.zh: 性能取决于可复用前缀和可静态表达的控制结构；外部工具延迟、分布式故障和动态程序变更不完全由该运行时解决。
limitations.en: Performance depends on reusable prefixes and expressible control structure; external-tool latency, distributed failures, and highly dynamic program changes are not fully addressed.

notes.zh: 模型、任务、硬件、基线与指标仅转录自官方 arXiv 摘要；摘要未披露的表格和部署细节仍待全文审计。
notes.en: Models, workloads, hardware, baselines, and metrics are transcribed only from the official arXiv abstract; undisclosed tables and deployment details still require full-text audit.
